enabled.description: Start the PTP daemon on service startup.

interface.description: Network interface to use for PTP traffic (must support PTP hardware timestamping for best accuracy).

clock_id.description: Optional 6-byte hexadecimal clock identity (e.g., 'a0:00:00:ff:fe:00:12:34'). Auto-generated if omitted.

domain.description: PTP domain number (0–127). Must match across all devices in the same PTP network.

mode.description: Operating mode: master-only, slave-only, both, or auto-detect.

allow_multiple_masters.description: Allow multiple active master sources in auto mode (for redundancy).

announce_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between Announce messages (must be ≥ 0.00390625 and ≤ 4).

sync_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between Sync messages (must be ≥ 0.00390625 and ≤ 4).

hardware_timestamping.description: Enable hardware timestamping (if supported by NIC and driver) for sub-microsecond precision.

utc_offset.description: Current UTC offset (seconds), as reported by the leap second table. Typical value: 37 (as of 2024).

clock_device.description: Path to the PTP clock device (e.g., /dev/ptp0). Found via ethtool -T.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Empty means log to stderr.

delay_mechanism.description: Delay measurement mechanism: peer-to-peer (p2p) or end-to-end (e2e).

initial_parent_variance.description: Initial variance used during startup before actual variance is measured (0.0–1.0).

allow_slave_with_higher_priority.description: Allow synchronization from a master with higher priority (e.g., during failover testing).

qos_dscp.description: DSCP value (0–63) for PTP packets. 0 disables marking.

peer_delay_measurement.description: Enable peer delay measurement for p2p mode.

peers.description: List of static peer IP addresses (for unicast or manual discovery).

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a peer PTP device.

ignore_addresses.description: List of addresses to ignore (e.g., loopback, virtual interfaces).

items.description: IP address (CIDR or exact) to exclude from PTP processing.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility for PTP daemon messages.

passive_mode.description: Enable passive mode (used in boundary or transparent clocks to allow bidirectional sync).

priority1.description: Priority1 value (0–255); lower means higher priority for master election.

priority2.description: Priority2 value (0–255); used for secondary master selection.

clock_accuracy.description: Clock accuracy indicator per IEEE 1588 Annex G (e.g., 'U' = ±150 ns).

offset_scaled_log_variance.description: Scaled log variance of offset (10^x ns²); typical range 15–30.

validate_master.description: Enable strict validation of master (e.g., check protocol version, domain).

max_foreign_master_records.description: Maximum number of foreign master records to retain for BMC algorithm.

fallback_to_software_timestamping.description: Fall back to software timestamping if hardware timestamping fails.

unicast_destinations.description: List of unicast destination addresses for PTP messages (requires unicastMode).

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a unicast peer.

unicast_mode.description: Enable unicast communication (instead of multicast). Must specify unicastDestinations.

auto_tune.description: Automatically adjust network buffers and other parameters for optimal performance.
